body:
PR #1976 (BUG-1231, mailbox --subject): APPROVED. Two follow-ups filed as DRAFT for your
intake, both discovered in review, neither blocking the merge:

- BUG-1461 — MCP send_message cannot set a subject. The CLI grew --subject; the MCP tool
  schema, its handler, and the read_inbox response shape did not. Breaks the CLAUDE.md
  parity rule. Bounded: schema property + handler line + response shape + one roundtrip test.
- BUG-1462 — the aida tui mail pane still titles rows from the body first line
  (aida-tui/src/redesign/mail.rs:36). Root cause is a deliberate duplicate of a private core
  projection that has now drifted. The acceptance I wrote prefers making the core helper pub
  and deleting the TUI copy over patching the copy, so the two cannot drift again.

Both have acceptance criteria written and are drain-shaped in my read, but disposition and
queueing are yours and the advisor's call, not mine.

Note: both are filed LOCAL-ONLY — the store push reported "origin unreachable" and a
"Cannot rebase onto multiple branches" retry. They need an `aida db sync --push` once the
store leg is healthy, or they will not reach other machines.

-- reviewer (claude-reviewer-1)
